findings.title: No line-level slips found in the changed hunks
findings.description: Read line by line, the changed lines have no wrong-variable use, inverted conditions, or misspelled symbols. The state check (`!= pipeline.signature`), the `access_token` and `login` presence checks, and the `installation_id is None` redirect all test the intended thing. The imports added in `integration.py` are all used. In the test changes, the test names (`test_github_user_mismatch`, the "Invalid installation request." assertions) match the behavior they exercise. The `pipeline_advancer.py` change keeps the same condition with `provider_id == "github"` in place of the removed constant.

findings.title: Identity-provider OAuth helper methods were not verified against their definitions
findings.description: `OAuthLoginView.dispatch` calls `ghip.get_oauth_client_id()`, `get_oauth_client_secret()`, `get_oauth_authorize_url()`, and `get_oauth_access_token_url()`, and `get_user_info` from `sentry.identity.github`. I could not open those definitions in this session, so I have not confirmed they exist with these names and signatures. This is a verification gap, not a detected defect.
